## Pull request overview

This pull request introduces a comprehensive **Schema-Driven Configuration Panel Framework** that reduces config panel implementations from 1500+ lines of imperative code to ~60-line declarative schemas. The framework consists of four core primitives (`ConfigPanelSchema` types, `useConfigDraft` hook, `ConfigFieldRenderer`, and `ConfigPanelRenderer`) in `@object-ui/components`, with `DashboardConfigPanel` serving as the first production implementation to validate the framework's effectiveness.

**Changes:**
- Added schema-driven config panel framework in `@object-ui/components` with 11 control types (input, switch, select, checkbox, slider, color, icon-group, field-picker, filter, sort, custom)
- Implemented `DashboardConfigPanel` in `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` covering layout, data refresh, and appearance settings
- Added comprehensive test coverage (65 tests across 4 test files) and 3 Storybook stories
- Updated all 10 locale files with `configPanel` i18n keys
- Updated ROADMAP.md marking Phase 0 and Phase 1 as complete

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 24 out of 24 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |

| `packages/components/src/custom/config-field-renderer.tsx` | Single field renderer supporting all 11 control types with custom render escape hatch |
| `packages/components/src/custom/config-panel-renderer.tsx` | Schema-driven panel renderer with header/breadcrumb, collapsible sections, and sticky save/discard footer |
| `packages/components/src/custom/index.ts` | Exports ConfigFieldRenderer and ConfigPanelRenderer from custom components |
| `packages/components/src/index.ts` | Exports useConfigDraft hook and ConfigPanelSchema types from main package |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/use-config-draft.test.tsx` | 10 tests covering draft initialization, mode handling, field updates, discard, callbacks, and source changes |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/config-field-renderer.test.tsx` | 22 tests covering all control types, visibility, placeholders, and custom render |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/config-panel-renderer.test.tsx` | 21 tests covering rendering, collapsible sections, conditional visibility, and footer behavior |
| `packages/components/src/stories/ConfigPanel.stories.tsx` | 3 Storybook stories demonstrating basic usage, dashboard configuration, and custom field escape hatch |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardConfigPanel.tsx` | First production implementation using the framework, defining layout/data/appearance configuration |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardConfigPanel.test.tsx` | 12 tests covering panel rendering, section expansion, field changes, and save/discard behavior |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx` | Exports DashboardConfigPanel and registers it in dashboardComponents |
| `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` | Added configPanel section with 16 keys (save, discard, close, layout, columns, gap, rowHeight, data, refreshInterval, appearance, title, showDescription, theme, configuration, general, advanced) to all 10 locale files |
| `ROADMAP.md` | Updated P1.10 Dashboard Config Panel marking Phase 0 (Component Infrastructure) and Phase 1 (Dashboard-Level Config Panel) as complete |
</details>
The type definitions use `React.ReactNode` but don't import React. This will cause a TypeScript compilation error. Add `import * as React from 'react';` at the top of the file to resolve this issue.

The `helpText` field is defined in the `ConfigField` type but is never rendered in the `ConfigFieldRenderer` component. Either implement rendering of the help text below controls (similar to how section hints are displayed), or remove this field from the type definition if it's not yet supported. For consistency with the existing codebase, help text should typically render below the field in a small, muted text style.
